candidates.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Generate exactly ONE isolated production city-map building sprite for tianshu, Northern Song central plains Kaifeng/Luoyang around 1093. Reference images supply only realistic ancient materials and detail density; never copy reference camera mistakes or southern lush vegetation. Historical realistic grey clay tile, warm grey plaster over earth and rough bricks, matte weathered timber; restrained subtle ochre and red where structural. NOT toy, plastic, miniature diorama or ink wash. Orthographic yaw45 elevation30, ground axes EXACT slopes +0.5/-0.5 (2:1 dimetric), parallel opposite edges, upright columns, NO perspective. South entrance faces screen LOWER LEFT. Entire isolated footprint on one extremely thin flat ground-contact parallelogram with left, bottom/front and right corners clearly visible for grid calibration. Only a shallow masonry contact strip, NO thick plinth. Upper-left screen illumination, short contact shadow towards lower-right. TRUE transparent RGBA background, at least10% clear margins all sides. All roof ends and ground corners visible. No text, writing, signs, symbols, watermark, people, surrounding city, sky, trees outside footprint, modern objects, Qing ornament, imperial yellow roofs, thick bases or checkerboard. Subject: one unmarked Northern Song cargo depot and caravan escort courtyard, plain grey-tiled warehouse main hall, side covered storage shed containing2 modest bundles and a cart within walls, packed earth court, broad plain wooden gate lower-left. Functional escort/depot appearance is an original game design, not a claim of a historical Song biaoju organization. Footprint14m east-west by11m north-south; front down-right edge / up-right edge ratio14/11. Paper-thin contact parallelogram; no flags, shields, weapon display or modern crates. All background alpha zero, no ambient haze or ground glow.
